approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 binary with ReXGlue; native Linux AppImage and Windows build with its own Qt launcher, in-game options menu, FSR and PipeWire audio
notes: v2.3 released: playable on Linux and Windows (test build). v2.3 brings a new launcher written for this project: its settings match the in-game menu, it imports your XBLA package directly and shows art from it, and it follows your light or dark theme; the AppImage can update itself (AppImageUpdate, Gear Lever). The AppImage is built on AlmaLinux 9 and needs only glibc 2.34 (Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, Fedora 35+, RHEL 9 family, Steam Deck, Arch). Earlier: an unlocked frame rate (the game's physics are frame-rate independent), lower input latency (guest-side frame pacing, a one-frame queue, mailbox vsync), an in-game options menu (F1 or L3+R3) with FSR/CAS upscaling, and an FPS overlay. Android pre-release. A fresh recomp: no earlier recomp or port of this game existed.
